name: @equin/plugin-framework-tooling-collected-dir-discovery
description: Collected-dir discovery: which `defineCollectedDir("<dir>")` markers the checkout declares, read from its file set (discoverCollectedDirsIn over a RepoFiles, discoverCollectedDirs with one blocking git ls-files, standardPluginDirsFromSnapshot over a tree build's snapshot) — no directory walk and no build tooling, so a serving backend can ask too.
